mapper.sql: level_id, level_code, level_name, level_order, monthly_order_requirement, inventory_requirement, invite_limit, registration_fee, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, is_delete
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_merchant_level WHERE is_delete = 0 ORDER BY level_order, level_id
SELECT FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_merchant_level WHERE level_id = #{levelId} AND is_delete = 0
SELECT FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_merchant_level WHERE status = '0' AND is_delete = 0 ORDER BY level_order, level_id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ry_rental.ry_rental_merchant_level(level_code, level_name, level_order, monthly_order_requirement, inventory_requirement, invite_limit, registration_fee, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, is_delete) VALUES(#{levelCode}, #{levelName}, #{levelOrder}, #{monthlyOrderRequirement}, #{inventoryRequirement}, #{inviteLimit}, #{registrationFee}, #{status}, #{createBy}, NOW(), #{createBy}, NOW(), #{remark}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE ry_rental.ry_rental_merchant_level SET level_name=#{levelName}, level_order=#{levelOrder}, monthly_order_requirement=#{monthlyOrderRequirement}, inventory_requirement=#{inventoryRequirement}, invite_limit=#{inviteLimit}, registration_fee=#{registrationFee}, status=#{status}, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=NOW(), remark=#{remark} WHERE level_id=#{levelId} AND is_delete=0
UPDATE ry_rental.ry_rental_merchant_level SET is_delete=1, update_by=#{operator}, update_time=NOW() WHERE level_id=#{levelId} AND is_delete=0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_member WHERE level_id=#{levelId} AND is_delete=0

SELECT c.invite_code_id inviteCodeId, c.tenant_id tenantId, c.member_id memberId, c.invite_code inviteCode, c.used_count usedCount, l.invite_limit inviteLimit FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_merchant_invite_code c INNER JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_member m ON m.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND m.member_id=c.member_id AND m.is_delete=0 INNER JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_merchant_level l ON l.level_id=m.level_id AND l.status='0' AND l.is_delete=0 WHERE c.invite_code=#{inviteCode} AND c.status='0' AND c.is_delete=0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT c.invite_code inviteCode, c.used_count usedCount, l.level_name levelName, l.invite_limit inviteLimit FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_member m INNER JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_merchant_level l ON l.level_id=m.level_id AND l.is_delete=0 LEFT JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_merchant_invite_code c ON c.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND c.member_id=m.member_id AND c.is_delete=0 WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND m.member_id=#{memberId} AND m.is_delete=0

SELECT i.invitation_id invitationId, m.member_code inviteeMemberCode, m.nickname inviteeName, i.invitee_phone inviteePhone, i.invite_status inviteStatus, DATE_FORMAT(i.registered_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') registeredTime FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_merchant_invitation i INNER JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_member m ON m.member_id=i.invitee_member_id AND m.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND m.is_delete=0 WHERE i.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND i.inviter_member_id=#{memberId} AND i.is_delete=0 ORDER BY i.registered_time DESC, i.invitation_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ry_rental.ry_rental_merchant_invite_code(tenant_id, member_id, invite_code, used_count, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_delete) VALUES(#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{code}, 0, '0', #{operator}, NOW(), #{operator}, NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE ry_rental.ry_rental_merchant_invite_code SET used_count=used_count+1, update_by='registration', update_time=NOW() WHERE invite_code_id=#{inviteCodeId} AND used_count < #{inviteLimit} AND status='0' AND is_delete=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ry_rental.ry_rental_merchant_invitation(tenant_id, invite_code_id, invite_code, inviter_member_id, invitee_member_id, invitee_phone, invite_status, registered_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_delete) VALUES(#{tenantId}, #{inviteCodeId}, #{code}, #{inviterId}, #{inviteeId}, #{phone}, 'registered', NOW(), 'registration', NOW(), 'registration', NOW(), 0)

INSERT INTO ry_rental.ry_rental_registration_payment(payment_no, member_id, contact_phone, amount, payment_status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_delete) SELECT #{paymentNo}, member_id, contact_phone, #{amount}, 'pending', 'registration', NOW(), 'registration', NOW(), 0 FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_member WHERE member_id=#{memberId} AND is_delete=0
mapper.select: SELECT p.payment_id paymentId, p.payment_no paymentNo, p.member_id memberId, p.amount amount, p.payment_status paymentStatus, m.registration_status registrationStatus FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_registration_payment p INNER JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_member m ON m.member_id=p.member_id AND m.is_delete=0 WHERE p.payment_no=#{paymentNo} AND p.is_delete=0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT payment_no paymentNo, amount paymentAmount, payment_status paymentStatus FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_registration_payment WHERE member_id=#{memberId} AND is_delete=0 ORDER BY payment_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ry_rental.ry_rental_registration_payment SET payment_status='paid', paid_time=NOW(), update_by='payment-confirm', update_time=NOW() WHERE payment_no=#{paymentNo} AND payment_status='pending' AND is_delete=0

UPDATE ry_rental.ry_rental_member SET registration_status='completed', auth_status='pending', update_by='payment-confirm', update_time=NOW() WHERE member_id=#{memberId} AND registration_status='awaiting_payment' AND is_delete=0
mapper.select: SELECT c.invite_code inviteCode, c.used_count usedCount, m.member_code inviterMemberCode, m.nickname inviterName, l.level_name levelName, l.invite_limit inviteLimit, i.invitation_id invitationId, invitee.member_code inviteeMemberCode, invitee.nickname inviteeName, i.invitee_phone inviteePhone, DATE_FORMAT(i.registered_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') registeredTime FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_merchant_invite_code c INNER JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_member m ON m.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND m.member_id=c.member_id AND m.is_delete=0 INNER JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_merchant_level l ON l.level_id=m.level_id AND l.is_delete=0 LEFT JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_merchant_invitation i ON i.invite_code_id=c.invite_code_id AND i.is_delete=0 LEFT JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_member invitee ON invitee.member_id=i.invitee_member_id AND invitee.is_delete=0 WHERE c.is_delete=0 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC, i.registered_time DESC
